source: engine AnimationTree on non-bone targets: Node3D n0..n5 (n4 position only) and blend shapes s0..s3 of a MeshInstance3D (targets 6..9, value in slot 0); script nodes emit clips A, B, C; Blend2 (filtered n2 n3 s1 s3) mixes A and B; Add2 adds C; RESET keys for n1 n3 s2; init from RESET only for the channel of the first track creating each node's cache (mixer order A, B, C, RESET), else identity/0; motion scale 1; values read from Node3D position/quaternion/scale and get_blend_shape_value after advance(0); nodes compare by transform (expect_xform.bin, 3x4 rows per node per frame), blend shapes by value
